# M0 Test Data

All generated media is synthetic and created locally by `generate.sh`.

- `sample-video.mp4`: ten-second color bars with a sine-wave audio track.
- `sample-audio.m4a`: ten-second sine-wave audio-only fixture.
- `multi-audio.mkv`: video with two distinguishable audio tracks.
- `long-timeline.srt`: 2,100 subtitle cues.
- `subtitles/timeline.srt` and `.vtt`: gaps, overlap, punctuation, apostrophe,
  hyphen, and line-break fixtures.

Generated files are intentionally ignored by Git and can be recreated.
